name: cendor-libs-js
description: Production plumbing for LLM applications — the TypeScript port of the Cendor libraries.

scripts.fixtures: cd ../cendor-libs && uv run python ../cendor-libs-js/scripts/gen-fixtures.py && uv run python ../cendor-libs-js/scripts/gen-fixtures-io.py

pnpm.//: Security floors for transitive dev dependencies (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg brace-expansion DoS, GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 postcss path traversal). Both arrive dev-only via rimraf>glob>minimatch and vitest>vite, so neither ships to consumers - but a floor here means a lockfile re-resolve can never reintroduce them. These are >= floors, not pins: remove them once every dependent's own range has moved past these versions.
